body:
Following Radner (1993). Just after a TV show, a company surveys viewers by phone. Its goal: gather data on the largest possible number of viewers within 4 time units. Every worker earns w, busy or not. During a single time unit, a worker either interviews one respondent or exchanges information with exactly one colleague, sending or receiving. When the 4 units end, one worker must hold all the data, and that worker reports the results. Specify what the company produces, compute its cost function, and study whether it is convex.

Answer

The product is the number of distinct respondents whose information reaches the announcer. With any workforce, a best schedule exists; no schedule surveys more than 8 respondents.
